content: ⌊ DRAFT g Service Name Mem_Write (draft) Syntax Std_ReturnType Mem_Write ( Mem_InstanceIdType instanceId, Mem_AddressType targetAddress, const Mem_DataType * sourceDataPtr, Mem_LengthType length ) Service ID [hex] 0x06 Sync/Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant instanceId ID of the related memory driver instance. targetAddress Physical write address (aligned to page size). sourceDataPtr Source data pointer (aligned to page size). Parameters (in) length Write length in bytes (aligned to page size). Parameters (inout) None 5 33 of 53 Document ID 1018: AUTOSAR_SWS_MemoryDriver Specification of Memory Driver AUTOSAR CP R21-11 4 Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: The requested job has been accepted by the module. E_NOT_OK: The requested job has not been accepted by the module. E_MEM_SERVICE_NOT_AVAIL: The service function is not implemented. Description Triggers a write job to store the passed data to the provided address area with given address and length. The result of this service can be retrieved using the Mem_GetJobResult API. If the write operation was successful, the job result is MEM_JOB_OK. If there was an issue writing the data, the result is MEM_FAILED. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via Mem.h
